releaseNotes:
- Premium Glass Morphism: Enhanced UI with consistent glass cards and glow effects across all screens.
- Dynamic Backgrounds: Time-of-day aware background shifts (Day/Night) with scroll parallax.
- Urgency Pulse & Heat Map: Bosses and events now pulse when ready, with urgent color-coded countdowns.
- Frozen Podium: Top 3 ranks are now sticky at the top for better visibility during scrolling.
- Glowing Search: Highly visible search highlighting with primary glow effects.
- Settings Revamp: New System Health dashboard, colored row icons, and a premium floating save bar.
- Vibrate Only Mode: New option for silent haptic alerts in settings.
- Performance & Stability: Modernized internal APIs and addressed deprecated warnings.
